subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should Copilot BYOK adopt 16 MiB and 30 seconds as unconditional fixed request-body boundaries for all supported custom providers?
rationale: The hardening is sound, but repository evidence does not establish an existing Copilot SDK or provider contract that makes those thresholds universally compatibility-safe.

options.title: Accept the fixed boundaries
options.body: Confirm that supported Copilot BYOK requests remain safely below both thresholds and merge the focused hardening as written.

options.title: Derive a documented ceiling
options.body: Adjust the constants to an SDK- or provider-contract-backed maximum and add a largest-supported-request regression case.

options.title: Pause for configurable policy
options.body: Hold the PR if legitimate provider-specific payloads may exceed one global limit and a broader limit policy is needed.

recommendation.title: Accept the fixed boundaries
recommendation.body: Confirm that supported Copilot BYOK requests remain safely below both thresholds and merge the focused hardening as written.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available review-routing signal in the PR timeline for accepting a compatibility-sensitive runtime boundary.
